hypothesis: A longitude-stratified 12-event pilot can retrieve and decode every required prior-day 00Z GEFS geavg/gespr local-day-overlap TMAX message with at least 98% message success, finite plausible values, bounded grid distance, and projected 70-event transfer below 2 GiB.

cohort.parent: 18h intersection of usable full market vector, admitted station coordinate, and publication-admissible GEFS inventory
cohort.selection: Sort parent events by longitude, latitude, target_date, event_id; select indices round(i*(N-1)/(12-1)) for i=0..11; deduplicate is forbidden.

forecast_contract.run_date: target local date minus one calendar day
forecast_contract.steps: all canonical six-hour blocks overlapping station-local target day
forecast_contract.range_download: Only the exact indexed 2m TMAX message byte range
forecast_contract.spread_unit: convert Kelvin-difference to Fahrenheit-difference by multiplying 9/5
